title: 门控残差在下游归一化商空间中的低响应 FFN 组动作

proposer.session_ref: FFNDS docs/96 + docs/97, created before discussion queue

origin.note: Imported from already recorded research; no claim of independent agent authorship or independent approval

mechanism.native_boundary: Wan I2V D-Q HiF4 FFN, 5120→13824→5120, AdaLN gate, residual writeback and following pre-LN consumers; runtime exception/adapter branches remain scope-specific
mechanism.action: Explore zero-completion 64-hidden-channel grouped FFN operators with loss informed by observable gated residual contribution; compare fixed and conditional group selection including physical packing cost
mechanism.mathematical_representation: P = I - 11^T/5120; e = diag(g)(F_candidate(q)-F_native_DQ(q)); projected error eta=P e. Finite normalizer may also have state-dependent near-null centered radial direction at local scale; score joint group effects, not just per-group norms
mechanism.distinguishing_feature: Changes output-space objective and joint response geometry rather than treating dense-row restoration, R256 compensation, or local FFN SSE as a prerequisite
mechanism.expected_compute_saving: Only if native 64-channel group omissions can eliminate Q2/W2 or larger physical work at acceptable video quality; a mathematical null direction by itself saves no material GEMM

competing_explanations: Projected mean component fraction is isotropic-like ~1/5120 of expected squared energy, hence practical cancellation too small
Old C1 row rank disagreement arises from residual scale and finite LayerNorm rather than omitted-group gauge
Signed group interaction or current residual radial attenuation is more important than the one-dimensional exact null
falsifiable_predictions: For any tested action with exact downstream pre-LN gauge cancellation and ideal exact arithmetic, nextnorm must be unchanged; old UB1/swap variants do NOT exhibit such no-change in native results
If the construction is useful, projected signed group Gram has materially different best equal-cost supports or lower finite nextnorm risk than unprojected group Gram on matched native states
Gains in math-only projected SSE do not imply wall-time advantage when quantization, packing and routing costs dominate
best_counterexample: For isotropic per-token error components with fixed g, the ratio of expected mean-direction energy to expected total gated energy is 1/5120. C1 native UB1/swap_A/swap_B have strictly nonzero nextnorm SSE in all 72 historic scopes.
